# LLCforLandlords

> Plain-English LLC guidance for landlords and rental property investors — real filing fees, real timelines, real trade-offs. Covers forming an LLC, transferring property, state-by-state setup, liability protection, taxes, and LLC-formation service reviews. General information, not legal or tax advice.

LLCforLandlords publishes operator-level guides for holding rental property in an LLC. Content is funded by affiliate links (see /affiliate-disclosure/) and produced under documented editorial standards (see /editorial-standards/). Articles are published under /llc-guide/.
